command.pulse-fabric.batching_chat_packe: When true, chat-related packets bypass the buffer for instant delivery.
command.pulse-fabric.batching_coalesce_b: Maximum number of sub-packets per BundlePacket. Vanilla client enforces a hard limit of 4096.
command.pulse-fabric.batching_coalesce_p: List of packet class names to coalesce into BundlePackets (e.g. particles, sounds). Supports inner classes with dot syntax (Foo.Bar).
command.pulse-fabric.batching_enabled.co: Master toggle for the smart packet batching system. When true, outgoing packets are buffered and flushed in batches instead of individually.
command.pulse-fabric.batching_flush_inte: Interval in milliseconds for the INTERVAL batching mode.
command.pulse-fabric.batching_ignored_pa: List of packet class names that should always bypass the buffer entirely.
command.pulse-fabric.batching_instant_pa: List of packet class names that should flush the buffer immediately when sent.
command.pulse-fabric.batching_max_batch_: Maximum bytes to buffer before forcing a flush.
Maximum number of packets to buffer before forcing a flush.
command.pulse-fabric.batching_mode.comme: Batching mode: smart_execution (flush on tick + limits), strict_tick (flush only on tick end), interval (flush on a timer).
command.pulse-fabric.batching_off_thread: When true, packets sent from off the server thread bypass the buffer.
command.pulse-fabric.batching_packet_coa: When true, packets in the coalesce list are bundled together into BundlePackets on flush, reducing the client's received packet count.
command.pulse-fabric.batching_safety_mar: Safety margin in bytes subtracted from the max batch bytes limit to prevent overflow.
command.pulse-fabric.batching_write_queu: When true, buffered packets are queued and written in a single event loop task instead of calling Connection.send() per packet, eliminating per-packet lambda allocations and cross-thread task scheduling.
command.pulse-fabric.metrics_enabled.com: When true, the metrics collection system is active and computes network statistics.
Enables the CPU metrics module (process CPU usage estimation).
command.pulse-fabric.metrics_module_memo: Enables the memory metrics module (saved allocation estimation).
command.pulse-fabric.metrics_module_netw: Enables the network metrics module (PPS, bandwidth).
command.pulse-fabric.metrics_module_writ: Enables the write queue metrics module (event loop task savings tracking).
command.pulse-fabric.metrics_update_inte: How often (in seconds) the metrics system recomputes derived statistics.
command.pulse-fabric.netstats.unknown_ty: Unknown stats type: %s. Use: network, cpu, ram, all
command.pulse-fabric.opt_explosions_bloc: Number of block changes in a single chunk required to trigger a full chunk resend instead of individual updates.
command.pulse-fabric.opt_explosions_enab: When true, block updates from explosions are grouped by chunk and replaced with full chunk resends if they exceed the threshold.
command.pulse-fabric.opt_explosions_log_: When true, logs a message each time the explosion optimization replaces block updates with a chunk resend.
